content: Mobile video/timeline scrubbing conventions 2026: swipe-to-seek along timeline, tap-anywhere-to-toggle-pause (after first tap reveals controls), double-tap for skip/seek-to-edge, drag scrub-bar for live preview (pause video, seek as bar moves), long-press for speed ramp, vertical swipe for brightness/volume (not applicable here). Fine control at low swipe velocity is expected on scrub bars.
